title: Yara and the Debt
author: Kestrel Villalobos
blurb: Ulyana Sterling, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
